COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(p.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalTrend, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(p.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(p.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS auditTotalTrend, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.audit_status = 1 AND DATE(p.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.audit_status = 2 AND DATE(COALESCE(p.audit_pass_time, p.update_time)) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approvedTrend, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.audit_status = 3 AND DATE(p.update_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.audit_status = 3 AND DATE(p.update_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejectedTrend, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.audit_status IN (2, 3) AND DATE(COALESCE(p.audit_pass_time, p.update_time)) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.audit_status IN (2, 3) AND DATE(COALESCE(p.audit_pass_time, p.update_time)) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reviewedTrend, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.service_status = 1 AND p.status != 0 AND DATE(p.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.service_status = 1 AND p.status != 0 AND DATE(p.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS availableTrend, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 0 AND DATE(p.update_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 0 AND DATE(p.update_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disabledTrend, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.organization, CAST(p.institution_id AS CHAR)) IS NOT NULL AND DATE(p.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN COALESCE(CONCAT('id:', p.institution_id), CONCAT('name:', p.organization)) END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.organization, CAST(p.institution_id AS CHAR)) IS NOT NULL AND DATE(p.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN COALESCE(CONCAT('id:', p.institution_id), CONCAT('name:', p.organization)) END) AS institutionTrend, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN DATE(p.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN p.rating END), 2), 0) - COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN DATE(p.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN p.rating END), 2), 0) AS averageRatingTrend, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(p.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN p.consultation_count ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(p.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN p.consultation_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalConsultationsTrend FROM `expert_profile` p
